Parallel-with-merge buys a 5x wall-clock speedup at a measured quality cost of ~0.2 nats at this scale. The embarrassment threshold did not fire, exactly as predicted.
p46_scoring.verdict: The hub at N=5, measured on all three routes in one run: knowledge composes through the store (a), weights compose only under bounded divergence (b), and parallelism is a wall-clock purchase, not a token-efficiency one (c). For the end architecture: the fleet brain is the shared store; frequent-sync weight merging is an OPS accelerator with a quantified price.
